description: Open the configured Snowflake account and confirm it: account, user, role, warehouse, and server version. Use this to verify the connector is reachable and the granted role is what you expect.
embedding_description: Verify the Snowflake connector is configured and reachable, and surface the resolved account, user, active role, warehouse, and server version — useful for confirming the operator-granted role is read-only as expected, or diagnosing a connection problem. No parameters.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with ok (bool), account, user, role, warehouse, version.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report ok plus the account/user/role/warehouse for the operator's confirmation; low sensitivity (connection metadata, data_sensitivity 0.1).

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: snowflake.not_configured: no snowflake_account address-book entry is registered, or it is incomplete. snowflake.auth_failed: the key-pair JWT was rejected (key revoked or mismatched). snowflake.api_error: an unexpected warehouse error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: snowflake.not_configured: register the snowflake_account address-book entry per the plugin's KB runbook. snowflake.auth_failed: ask the operator to verify the RSA public key on the connecting Snowflake user is still active.
